newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end higher on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end higher on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended higher on Wednesday mainly on buying of select blue-chip energy and chemical stocks, but sentiment was mixed amid concerns about the country's weak economic fundamentals, dealers said.

"The market appears range-bounded at present as genuine investors and foreigners are in a wait-and-see mood because the country's near-term economic outlook remains grim," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "The government's economic package will have a positive impact in the next six to 12 months."
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 9.98 points, or 0.63 percent, to 1,603.58. Gainers beat losers 148 to 127.
Turnover rose to 45.85 million shares from 42.32 million on Tuesday.
Engro Chemicals rose 6.0 rupees to 156, Shell Pakistan 6.0 to 230 and PTCL 0.40 to 30.40. Hub Power fell 0.55 to 37.70.
